definitions.explanation: Describes something continuing for an extremely long time without end. Often implies tedium or exhaustion.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{延々|えんえん}と{続|つづ}いた。
{彼|かれ}は{延々|えんえん}と{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}い{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: He kept complaining on and on.

examples.japanese: {延々|えんえん}と{続|つづ}く{道|みち}を{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked along the seemingly endless road.

notes:
{延々|えんえん} emphasizes excessive length or duration, often with a negative connotation of tedium.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {延々|えんえん}と{続|つづ}く: to continue endlessly
- {延々|えんえん}と{話|はな}す: to talk on and on

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {永遠|えいえん}に: eternally (neutral/positive)
- だらだら: dragging on (more casual)
- いつまでも: forever
